author: NASASpaceflight
description:
This Week In Spaceflight, Starship Flight 15 completed a full orbital mission profile with Ship 42 deploying Starlink satellites before returning to Starbase for its first successful chopstick catch after more than 21 hours in space, finally turning years of renderings into reality even as the booster diverted offshore following a low-fuel alarm.

We also cover ULA’s Vulcan returning to flight with six solid rocket boosters and a shortened Centaur but failing to reach orbit for the first time while carrying Amazon Leo satellites, ISRO’s ground test of an improved PSLV third stage after two similar in-flight failures, and Axiom’s lawsuit alleging Vast copied proprietary Private Astronaut Mission documents.

Additional updates include Euclid’s large data release, Roman Space Telescope commissioning progress, AxEMU and ispace lunar milestones, and the latest launch traffic featuring Rocket Lab’s 100th Electron.
